reviews.comment: Attendance is graded. Lectures are boring, but he tries. You have to memorize the entire lecture if you want a good grade. Very memorization-based class.

Prof's first exam was so terrible he started giving out tons of partial and participation grades and made next exams cake walks. Nice guy but boring lectures. Pretty difficult to take notes if you cant write fast. He would spend each class on one problem because he shows every, single, step, ten million times over. But ended up w/ good grade.

Note taking is tedious, but properly explains material. Uploads notes and other resources online. Homework isn't too hard but it is a lot, so allot plenty time before deadlines. Exams were easy, allowed one formula sheet with anything you want on it. Started to do attendance quizzes halfway through the semester, so show up. Easy A, very chill
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: So, I'm a student in the 4th week of class. Notes are IMPOSSIBLE to keep up with in class and the professor moves at the speed of a rocket. Today I resorted to taking photos during the lecture because I couldn't keep up...75 pics in 25 minutes. The notes were posted online and the prof makes himself available for help through email. Do NOT TAKE IMO
